name: task-planning
description: Task planning skills for Manus-style persistent markdown planning, progress tracking, and session recovery.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent markdown planning skills for complex agent workflows.
interface.longDescription: Task Planning packages OthmanAdi/planning-with-files as Codex skills for Manus-style file-based planning. It imports the canonical planning-with-files skill plus Arabic, German, Spanish, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese variants, with their templates and helper scripts for task_plan.md, findings.md, progress.md, plan attestation, progress checks, and session recovery.
defaultPrompt: Use planning-with-files to plan this multi-step task.
Create task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md for this project.
Resume the active file-based plan and update progress.
